landing.badge: Designed for Diverse Indian Agro-Climatic Zones
landing.hero_title: AI-Powered Personal Farming Assistant for All Indian Farmers
landing.hero_subtitle: Empowering smallholder farmers across India with localized weather intelligence, early crop disease diagnosis, real-time mandi prices, and native AI advisory in regional languages.
landing.features_subtitle: Engineered to address diverse farming challenges across Indian states — from monsoon variations to cash crop security.
landing.feat_ai_desc: Multilingual conversational intelligence providing context-aware guidance on crop care, fertilizers, organic methods, and government schemes.
landing.feat_weather_desc: District-level microclimate forecasts with actionable agricultural advisories to protect crops from sudden downpours and weather fluctuations.
landing.feat_health_desc: Vision-assisted diagnosis for crop afflictions, fungal infections, and pest infestations across Indian agricultural crops.
landing.feat_market_desc: Transparent price tracking across Indian APMC agricultural markets for grains, pulses, cash crops, and vegetables.
landing.feat_farm_desc: Organized records of your plots, crop cycles, irrigation tasks, and yield history tailored for smallholders.
landing.regional_focus_desc: India's agricultural landscape is rich and diverse — spanning Karnataka's fertile plateaus, Andhra & Telangana's cotton and chilli hubs, Tamil Nadu's delta paddy, Kerala's spices, and the Indo-Gangetic wheat-rice belts.
landing.regional_crops_list: Paddy • Wheat • Cotton • Sugarcane • Maize • Spices • Coconut • Groundnut • Pulses • Vegetables
landing.cta_banner_title: Ready to experience modern agricultural technology?
landing.cta_banner_desc: Explore the interactive taskbar and dashboard to preview next-generation farmer-first AI assistance.

dashboard.title: Farmer Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Daily agricultural overview and advisory briefing for your farm
dashboard.sample_advisory: Moderate rainfall expected across the district. Defer scheduled pesticide spraying until clear skies return.
dashboard.rec_1_desc: Recommended application of balanced NPK and micronutrient mixture for standing crops this week.
dashboard.rec_2_desc: Regulate drip irrigation valves and inspect drainage channels to avoid waterlogging in low basins.
dashboard.rec_3_desc: Scout crops for early signs of stem borer, aphid colonies, and fungal foliar lesions.
dashboard.alert_action: Recommended: Spray organic neem formulation or recommended fungicide on affected rows in early morning.
dashboard.task_pest: Scout field borders for pest migration
dashboard.task_harvest: Prepare harvest equipment for mature plots
dashboard.ai_quick_subtitle: Instant answers for Indian farmers in regional languages and English
dashboard.ai_input_placeholder: Ask a farming question in your preferred language...
dashboard.prompt_1: How to manage pest infestation in standing crops?
dashboard.prompt_2: Current government subsidies for micro-irrigation and solar pumps?
dashboard.prompt_3: Best organic fertilizer practices for higher crop yield?

modules.ai_assistant_subtitle: Multilingual conversational intelligence powered by Gemini LLM with agricultural knowledge retrieval (RAG).
modules.weather_subtitle: District-level microclimate data and agro-meteorological advisories from India Meteorological Department (IMD).
modules.crop_health_subtitle: Computer vision model trained to classify agricultural plant pathogens from leaf photographs.
modules.market_prices_subtitle: Live market rates across APMC mandis, state agricultural marketing boards, and Agmarknet.
modules.my_farm_subtitle: Digital ledger for plot boundaries, soil health records, crop rotation history, and input tracking.
modules.settings_subtitle: Configure interface language, default state & district, notifications, and offline preferences.
